title: Add projection builder

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 projection-builder capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: No current-head Python package implements a PCSM projection builder. The closest reusable controls are SymbolicContractGraph@1's deterministic graph projector, SemanticProjectionStore@1's opaque typed-state persistence, and the closed residual candidate-output grammar selected by PCSM-041. None accepts a canonical PCSM semantic slice, bounded alias table, semantic-anchor decision, and exact PCSM source-map/tree identity together; none emits a compact proof-relevant PCSM projection and receipt. Exact declared-output authority excludes the missing package and its direct tests, so this receipt records a fail-closed unavailable/non-promotion disposition rather than creating a wrapper or competing authority.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The prescribed suite passes but covers only structured candidate decoding. A versioned PCSM builder contract, source-map-bound input, projection output/CID, and package-specific positive and negative vectors are absent at this exact head.

symbolic_contract_graph.determinism_and_cid_binding: It uses deterministic DAG-JSON canonicalization and strict-dag-json-v1 CIDv1 DAG-JSON content identities. Its private _ProjectionBuilder rejects conflicting stable node keys and project_symbolic_contract_graph builds typed graph nodes and edges from a caller-supplied repository/AST index and snapshot_id.
symbolic_contract_graph.non_equivalence: This is a SwissKnife contract-graph projection, not a PCSM minification builder. It does not discover or bind the exact PCSM source forest itself, require a PCSM source-map CID, accept the PCSM-045 alias-table output or PCSM-044 anchor decision, produce compact projection text/bytes, or issue a PCSM projection receipt. Its version is graph version "1", not a versioned PCSM builder contract.

semantic_projection_store.behavior: It persistently records already-created opaque semantic-root and capsule projections through an attached typed Quack state client, checks tree-bound federation bindings, and rejects direct database paths.
semantic_projection_store.non_equivalence: It neither constructs source projections nor reads the PCSM forest. It requires caller-supplied projections, federation state, revisions, event IDs, and idempotency keys; it has no PCSM slice, alias table, semantic-anchor input, compact projection serializer, PCSM source-map CID, or PCSM projection receipt.

structured_candidate_grammar.behavior: The PCSM-041-selected closed grammar parser rejects malformed or unbounded candidate model output and uses content-derived grammar/result/output identities.
structured_candidate_grammar.non_equivalence: It parses candidate output only and preserves candidate_only status. It does not build a semantic projection, establish a PCSM source-map/tree binding, or grant mutation, proof, validation, promotion, or completion authority.
